meta.description: NTCSA's 'Estimated Rooftop PV' (Weekly System Status Report) counts every PV installation without an NTCSA contract, wheeled ground-mounted plant included. '2025, as modelled' uses the calendar-2025 mean of that series less the wheeled solar of the time. This puts 2026 on the same basis (planning practice: the year's average for that year; the trajectory from the latest installed level):   - monthly national points as published (below); January-April 2026 interpolated linearly between December 2025 and May 2026;   - less wheeled private solar inside the series from its commercial operation: the H1 2026 PFL plants (nodal/pfl_cod_h1_2026.json),     the pre-2026 named plants (Selemela 2 and 3, Damlaagte; build_capacity.py PRE2026_PRIVATE) and SunCentral 1 from October 2026     (in c6a's 2026 build floor as utility solar);   - October-December 2026 not yet published: the series without wheeled plant grows at its December 2025 - September 2026 pace. Writes nodal/rooftop_ntcsa_2026.json: the monthly series, the 2026 mean (FIXED.rooftopMW; validate_capacity.js asserts it) and the end-2026 level (the pathway's 2027 starting point, ROOF_FROM_END2026).
